cards.text: Amos, one of the sheep breeders of Tekoa, has a message from God for Israel (Amos 1:1). God has sent trouble after trouble, and every time, Israel did not return to Him (Amos 4:6-11). Now Amos calls out, 'Hear this word, O house of Israel…' and he takes up something against them.

cards.question: What does Amos take up against the house of Israel?

cards.text: Here's how it opens: 'Fallen is Virgin Israel…' Friend, that's giving the eulogy while the person is sitting in the front row LISTENING.

cards.question: Amos says fallen Israel lies abandoned on her land, with ___ to raise her up.

cards.text: The lament says she'll never rise again. Then the Lord GOD speaks about what's left when a city in Israel marches out.

cards.question: A city in Israel marches out a thousand strong. How many will it have left?
And the city that marches out a hundred strong? True or false: It will have just ten left.

cards.text: After all that heavy news, the LORD speaks to the house of Israel. And friend, listen close to this one.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell the house of Israel?

cards.text: Then He gets specific: don't seek Bethel or go to Gilgal, where Israel brings its sacrifices (Amos 4:4-5), and don't journey to Beersheba. That's like getting invited to a friend's house and spending the whole night hugging the front door.

cards.question: God warns Israel away from Gilgal and Bethel. What does He say will happen to those places?

answers.text: Gilgal will go into exile and Bethel will come to nothing
Gilgal will be rebuilt and Bethel will grow strong
Gilgal will be spared and Bethel will become a fortress

cards.text: Then the call comes again: seek the LORD and live, or He will sweep through the house of Joseph, the families that came from Joseph.

cards.question: If they don't seek Him, the LORD will sweep through the house of Joseph like ___.
That fire will devour everything. True or false: Someone at Bethel will be able to put it out.

cards.text: Then the message turns to a certain group: 'There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.'

Then comes a picture of who the LORD is: He made the Pleiades and Orion. Friend, every cookie box we seal lights ONE star in my sky, and I take a victory lap on my base every time, but He made whole constellations.

cards.question: True or false: The One who made the Pleiades and Orion also summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth.

cards.text: And this same God isn't done. Next up: the strong, and their stronghold.

cards.question: True or false: Fury will come even upon the stronghold of the strong.

cards.text: Next comes another group: 'There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity.' Friend, that's getting MAD at the smoke detector.
Then comes a therefore: they trample on the poor and take a tax of grain from him. And they've built stone houses.

cards.question: What does God say about the stone houses they've built?

answers.text: They will never live in them
They will go to the poor

cards.question: They've planted lush vineyards too. True or false: They'll get to drink the wine from them.

cards.text: Build it and never live in it, which is like stamping a whole batch and never getting ONE cookie. Then the LORD says, 'For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous.'

cards.question: The LORD says they oppress the righteous. How?
True or false: When the poor come to the gate, they get a fair hearing.

cards.text: Then comes a line about the prudent, and what they do when the days are this evil.

cards.question: True or false: In days this evil, the prudent keep silent.

cards.text: But the call comes back again: 'Seek good, not evil, so that you may live.' Different words, same heartbeat as 'Seek Me and live!'

cards.question: If Israel seeks good, what does the LORD, the God of Hosts, say He will do?

cards.text: Then comes a little tag: 'as you have claimed.' So Israel's already been saying the LORD is with them.

cards.question: The LORD keeps calling to the house of Israel: 'Hate evil and love good; establish ___ in the gate.'

cards.text: Then comes one little word: perhaps. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer holding my breath every time the light came in, so trust me, a perhaps from God is a BIG word.

cards.question: Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to whom?

cards.text: Then the LORD, the God of Hosts, the Lord, says what's coming: wailing in all the public squares and cries of 'Alas! Alas!' in all the streets.

cards.question: True or false: Even the farmer will be summoned to mourn.

cards.text: And it doesn't stay in the streets. There will be wailing in all the vineyards too.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say there will be wailing in all the vineyards?

answers.text: He will pass through their midst
He will hide His face from them
He will send a famine on them
